Exercise 10. 1. The Egyptian community of Milan organized a big party on the occasion of the Eid. 2. The city council did not accept the request of the inhabitants to suspend the construction work. 3. The closure of the road caused a strong traffic jam in the center. 4. Many students suffer from the increase in housing costs. 5. This year three new countries joined the agreement (the Convention). 6. The museum recovered a statue that had been stolen 20 years ago. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧العِيد⁩ without any other specification is one of the two main Islamic festivals: the Eid, or, if the context clarifies it, the Feast of the end of Ramadan, the Feast of the Sacrifice. in 2 ⁧بِإِيقَافِ⁩ depends on ⁧طَلَب⁩ : (a) the request to suspend the suspension; in 6 ⁧كَانَ قَدْ سُرِقَ⁩ It's a passive flaw.
⁧قَبْلَ سَنَتَيْنِ اِنْتَقَلْتُ إِلَى مَكْتَبٍ جَدِيدٍ فِي وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ. فِي الأُسْبُوعِ الأَوَّلِ عَانَيْتُ كَثِيرًا: لَمْ أَعْرِفْ أَحَدًا، وَلَمْ⁩
⁧أَفْهَمْ نِظَامَ العَمَلِ. اِشْتَكَيْتُ لِأَصْدِقَائِي كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ! لٰكِنِّي اِعْتَدْتُ شَيْئًا فَشَيْئًا. اِخْتَرْتُ أَنْ أَصِلَ مُبَكِّرًا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ⁩
⁧لِأَتَحَدَّثَ مَعَ الزُّمَلَاءِ، وَاِنْضَمَمْتُ إِلَى فَرِيقِ كُرَةِ القَدَمِ فِي الشَّرِكَةِ. اِسْتَفَدْتُ كَثِيرًا مِنْ نَصَائِحِ زَمِيلٍ قَدِيمٍ،⁩
⁧وَأَصَرَّ هُوَ عَلَى أَنْ يُسَاعِدَنِي فِي المَلَفَّاتِ الصَّعْبَةِ. فِي نِهَايَةِ الشَّهْرِ اِسْتَقْرَرْتُ تَمَامًا، وَاِنْتَهَيْتُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَشْرُوعٍ⁩
⁧لِي. لَمْ أَتَوَقَّعْ أَنْ يَكُونَ الشَّهْرُ الأَوَّلُ صَعْبًا إِلَى هٰذَا الحَدِّ، لٰكِنِّي الآنَ أُؤْمِنُ بِأَنَّ كُلَّ بِدَايَةٍ صَعْبَةٌ.⁩

Exercise 12. a) An institute near Zamalek, with morning lessons and cultural activities in the afternoon. At an Egyptian family, already contacted. Arrived in Italy, Sāra lived with an Italian family and in a month he learned more Italian than in a year. Ask for permission to work and suspend your gym membership for a month. The boss hasn't answered yet, but Luca will keep asking. b) He finished his master's degree; it was hard but the result is good. He will continue at the police station, but he hopes one day to work in an international organization. To an association of translators, who organized a legal translation workshop and chose it for a small project. He didn't cancel it, he sent it back to when the office job calmed down. c) 1. Sāra to Luke: he called him twice, asked if he finished the exam and called her back. 2. The university sports club for students: free swimming course, registration by the end of the week. 3. The manager of a company to employees (news): meeting this morning, offices closed Friday for maintenance. 4. Weather forecast, to citizens: rain until tomorrow evening, improvement from Sunday, we recommend to dress heavy.
